definitions.name: x2611_15723_cycleShuffle
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15723_cycleShuffle {k l : ℕ}
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + l))) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun π =>
    ∃ (e : Fin k ↪o Fin (k + l)) (f : Fin l ↪o Fin (k + l)),
      Disjoint (Set.range e) (Set.range f) ∧
      Set.range e ∪ Set.range f = Set.univ ∧
      (∀ i, π (e i) = e (σ i)) ∧ (∀ j, π (f j) = f (τ j)))
definitions.notes: Definition 1.1 via the printed equivalent invariant-subset description. The increasing embeddings are the standardizations of the two complementary invariant subsets.

definitions.name: x2611_15723_shuffle
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15723_shuffle {k l : ℕ}
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + l))) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun π =>
    (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k => (σ i).val)).Sublist
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (k + l) => (π i).val)) ∧
    (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin l => k + (τ j).val)).Sublist
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (k + l) => (π i).val)))
definitions.notes: The usual shuffle of the one-line word of σ with the word of τ shifted by k.

definitions.name: x2611_15723_noOrderIso
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15723_noOrderIso {k l : ℕ}
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Fin k) (b : Fin l),
    ¬ ∃ e : {x : Fin k // σ.SameCycle a x} ≃o
        {y : Fin l // τ.SameCycle b y},
      ∀ x y : {z : Fin k // σ.SameCycle a z},
        σ x.val = y.val → τ (e x).val = (e y).val
definitions.notes: No cycle of σ is order-isomorphic to a cycle of τ. An order isomorphism of orbit supports must intertwine the permutations. SameCycle includes fixed-point singleton cycles.

definitions.name: x2611_15723_qchoose
definitions.notes: Gaussian binomial polynomial evaluated at q, defined by the k-subset formula. This polynomial definition includes q = 0, 1 and roots of unity without a quotient singularity.

definitions.name: x2611_15723_zchoose
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15723_zchoose (n k : ℤ) : ℕ :=
  if 0 ≤ n ∧ 0 ≤ k then Nat.choose n.toNat k.toNat else 0
definitions.notes: Ordinary binomial coefficient with signed indices, zero for negative lower indices or negative upper indices. The upper indices in Corollary 1.7 are nonnegative.

definitions.name: x2611_15723_fundamental
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15723_fundamental (m n : ℕ) (J : Finset ℕ)
    (x : Fin m → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ∑ w : Fin n → Fin m,
    if Monotone w ∧
        (∀ i j : Fin n, j.val = i.val + 1 → i.val + 1 ∈ J → w i < w j)
    then ∏ i : Fin n, x (w i) else 0
definitions.notes: Finite-alphabet evaluation F_{n,J}(x_1,...,x_m,0,...), with weakly increasing indices and strict rises at J. Requiring identities for every m and every rational x is equivalent to the printed homogeneous formal-series identities.

definitions.name: x2611_15723_psi
definitions.notes: The operator Ψ on a fundamental function, viewed as a power series in t after rational specialization of q. Its t^m coefficient is F_{n,J}(1,q,...,q^{m-1},0,...).

statements.label: Theorem 1.6
statements.name: x2611_15723_thm1_6
statements.original:
For every $\sigma\in\mathcal{S}_{k}$ and $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_{n-k}$ with no order-isomorphic cycles,

 $\sum_{\pi\in\sigma\shuffle_{c}\tau}F_{n,\Des(\pi)}=\sum_{\pi^{\prime}\in\sigma\shuffle\tau}F_{n,\Des(\pi^{\prime})}.$ 

(1)

Equivalently, for any pair $\sigma\in\mathcal{S}_{k}$ and $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_{n-k}$ with no order-isomorphic cycles,
the statistic $\Des$ has the same distribution on the set of
shuffles-by-cycle
 $\sigma\shuffle_{c}\tau$ as on the set of standard shuffles $\sigma\shuffle\tau$ .
